name: slidev-theme-bestony2026
description: Crimson Deck — a dark, crimson-accented Slidev theme for technical reviews and product updates, with 27 layouts, 8 themed ECharts chart types, and Mermaid / PlantUML support.
author: Bestony

scripts.screenshot:all: pnpm screenshot:preview && pnpm screenshot:layouts && pnpm screenshot:accents

//devDependencies: hono and markdown-it are not imported here. Both reach the tree as auto-installed peers (@slidev/cli's MCP server, and @comark/markdown-it which peers on markdown-it ^14), where pnpm overrides don't apply and pnpm picks a version outside the peer range. Declaring them directly is the only way to pin them: hono carried CVEs, and markdown-it 15 dropped the lib/token.mjs subpath that @comark/markdown-it imports, which aborts slidev build. Drop each once its parent resolves it correctly on its own.
